name: Simple Stereo
summary: Sparse feature-based stereo matching on rectified left/right images using 1D epipolar correlation. Outputs a matched preview, matches JSON, 3D point cloud, and mean 3D position.

maxDisparity.label: Max disparity (px)
maxDisparity.description: Maximum horizontal pixel difference (d = ul - ur) to search.

patchRadius.label: Patch radius (px)
patchRadius.description: Half-window size for correlation matching (patch width = 2*r + 1).

vTolerance.label: Vertical tolerance (px)
vTolerance.description: Vertical search band around vl (for slightly imperfect rectification).

minCorrelation.label: Min correlation score
minCorrelation.description: Normalized cross-correlation threshold for accepting matches.

baselineMm.label: Baseline (mm)
baselineMm.description: Physical distance between left and right camera optical centers in mm.

fx.label: Focal length fx (px)
fx.description: Rectified camera focal length in pixels. Blackfly 1288x964 with a 12 mm lens is nominally 3200 px; use calibrated values when available.

fy.label: Focal length fy (px)
fy.description: Rectified camera vertical focal length in pixels. Blackfly 1288x964 with a 12 mm lens is nominally 3200 px; use calibrated values when available.

cx.label: Principal point cx (px, -1 = center)
cx.description: Principal point horizontal coordinate (-1 defaults to width/2).

cy.label: Principal point cy (px, -1 = center)
cy.description: Principal point vertical coordinate (-1 defaults to height/2).
